description: Variation of Conditions 2, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 28, 30, 31, 32, 34, 35  and removal of Condition 14 (Road Safety Audit) attached to planning permission reference 232616 granted 30/01/2026, amended by reference 260391 granted 17/07/2026, to allow for:“Demolition of existing buildings and construction of buildings ranging between two and six storeys across Sites A and B, comprising 361m2 of Class E commercial floorspace at ground floor and 47 residential units, together with 2 disabled parking spaces, cycle stores, refuse stores and landscaping.”Amendments to Condition 2 (Approved Plans):Subdivision of the Site B commercial unit into two units and extension of footprint.Reconfiguration of all flats across the ground, first, second, third, fourth and fifth floors.Removal of the Site B sixth floor and raising of the Site B fifth‑floor parapets to the corner block and raising of the second‑floor service yard parapet.Replication of the Site B third‑floor layout at fourth‑floor level to the middle block on Coopers Lane.Introduction of a new 1‑bed unit and associated access changes at Site B fifth‑floor level.Internal reconfiguration of corridors, stair cores, MEP risers and means of escape within Site B.Increase to internal floor heights and building heights.Fenestration changes (reduction in size of glazed shopfront and number of doors to Site B glazed shopfront commercial doors on the High Road Leyton elevation.Separate final means of escape door introduced on Cooper’s Lane elevation.Fenestration amendments to the internal courtyard (small adjustment to window and door positions and omission of a glazed panel to a window) .Amendments to Conditions 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 28, 30, 31 and 32 to distinguish between Site A and Site B and Condition 34 (Wheelchair units) to update the trigger point relating to M4(3) adaptable units.
